name: pont-familia
description: Puente personal hacia Web Família (GVA): API bridge + webapp accesible

scripts.dev: concurrently -n bridge,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @pont/bridge" "npm run dev -w @pont/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pont/web && node scripts/copy-web-dist.mjs && npm run build -w @pont/bridge
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pont/bridge && npm run typecheck -w @pont/web
